primary_tcrb.observations: A broad target source is visible in all three epochs; recurring neighbors are consistent. These images cannot test disappearance and are not calibrated flux measurements.

primary_v404cyg.observations: No distinct event source is established. Event plate field limit is only B10.847 and pre-event APASS depth is missing; no defensible on/off measurement follows.

exploratory_v404cyg.observations: The event image shows a broad source near the requested position, while adjacent same-series images show no comparable source. Bright neighbors recur. Catalog local non-detection limits are 13.975210 and 13.777783 versus event magnitude 12.878624. Broad sampling, modest astrometric offsets, and background structure remain; this is not calibrated subtraction or an empirical false-positive rate.
exploratory_v404cyg.analysis_status: Exploratory amendment specified after the failed primary images and before these three image downloads; original failed gate preserved.
